text:
tara: quick postmortem follow-up for the midnight OOM on c64-watcher. root cause looks like per-tenant watcher registry holding references after client disconnect + jemalloc fragmentation. posting concise remediation plan.

ben: thanks. can you list owners and short due dates so I can schedule windows?

li: quick datapoints: kv_residency_per_tenant spiked for tenant t-42, watcher_ref_count stayed high after session close. jemalloc retained_bytes ~+13% vs rss; background purge inactive. logs: `2026-03-22T00:12:03Z WARN watcher: dangling ref id=abc123 tenant=t-42`.

tara: actions:
- T1: run distributed leak-scan focusing on watcher registry refs (owner: @li) due: 2026-03-24
- T2: add per-tenant max_residency cap (config-only, soft-evict) and enable in staging (owner: @ben) due: 2026-03-23
- T3: tune jemalloc background_thread=true and lower epoch decay_ms for staging canaries (owner: @tara) due: 2026-03-25
- T4: implement targeted slab compaction for small objects in KV allocator (design doc + flag) (owner: @li) due: 2026-04-01
- T5: add alert "watcher_dangling_refs" and a runbook step to flip per-tenant cap (owner: @ops-bot) due: 2026-03-22

ben: scheduling T2 to staging 2026-03-23 03:00 UTC. will monitor per-tenant kv_residency, p95, and error-rate for 4h.

li: starting T1 now, will upload pointer traces and a small flamegraph to gs://redwood-perf/watcher/2922223333/.

tara: note on T3: enabling background_thread can reduce retained pages but may increase small pause spikes; keep behind flag and canary at 5%. rollback if p95 > baseline+30ms.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: staging config change for T2 scheduled by ben at 2026-03-23 03:00 UTC. CI: green.

pager-duty: added runbook entry "watcher-residency-surge" with quick-toggle steps, escalation template, and heuristic: if jemalloc.retained_bytes / rss > 1.10 and watcher_dangling_refs > 100 -> prioritize compaction.

ben: will post staging graphs after the 4h smoke test. if results good, we can rollout config-only to 20% prod next week.

li: uploaded artifacts. small write-up: most dangling refs traced to delayed session cleanup in the connection reaper; adding explicit drain in close path looks promising as a fast fix.

tara: good. add the explicit drain as a small patch (feature-flagged) and test in staging before compactor. low-risk path first.

all: ack. update this thread with blockers or when tasks complete. :white_check_mark:
